pages.title: An Expedition, Not a Home
pages.text:
Prepare above. Go down with a loadout. Take what you came for. Come back up.

Dying costs the run, never the base. Your body stays where it fell and everything you carried is still on it.

pages.title: What to Bring
pages.text:
Light you do not have to place. Food. A way out that is not the way in.

The deep band pays in VALUE - diamond, redstone, gold, lapis. The shallow band pays in VOLUME. Know which one you came for before you leave.
